---
name: admin-dashboard-cards
# description uses trigger phrases so the agent will include it when the user asks about cards or admin dashboard UI
description: "Use when working on the front-end admin dashboard; design or implement dashboard cards with the existing color scheme and avoid backend logic."
applyTo: "app/**,components/**"
---

When the user asks for help with the administrative dashboard or UI cards, focus on:

1. Front-end implementation only (React / Next.js components, CSS/CSS modules).
2. Reusable card components that match the project's existing color scheme and styling.
3. Layout and accessibility of cards; include examples of JSX/HTML and styling.
4. Do **not** discuss backend routes, database models, or server logic in these responses.

This instruction ensures the agent stays in the UI domain and quickly provides design and code for admin dashboard cards.
